title: The Photo Booth
narration: The photo booth printed a picture of someone standing behind me. Successive photographs showed a glove, a syringe and my unconscious body inside a van. Police discovered a hidden camera transmitting to a kidnapper outside. My strip contained a message saying its final picture had been changed. The remote account belonged to the first woman he abducted. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. He had forced her to select new victims, but she had altered my photograph to help me escape.
